title: 第32课 · 下次我一定能考好
subtitle: Lesson 32 — 下次我一定能考好 · Next time I'll do well

items.py: Xià cì wǒ yīdìng néng kǎo hǎo.
items.en: Next time I'll definitely do well on the exam.

items.zh: 这次考试你考得怎么样？
items.py: Zhè cì kǎoshì nǐ kǎo de zěnmeyàng?
items.en: How did you do on this exam?

items.py: Wǒ kǎo de bú tài hǎo.
Nǐ néng kàn dǒng zhè běn shū ma?
Wǒ bú huì, dànshì wǒ xiǎng xué.
items.en: I can't, but I want to learn.

items.zh: 刘京：这次考试你考得怎么样？
items.py: Liú Jīng: Zhè cì kǎoshì nǐ kǎo de zěnmeyàng?
items.en: Liu Jing: How did you do on this exam?

items.zh: 大卫：考得不太好。听力还可以，语法不太好。
items.py: Dàwèi: Kǎo de bú tài hǎo. Tīnglì hái kěyǐ, yǔfǎ bú tài hǎo.
items.en: David: Not very well. Listening was OK, grammar wasn't good.

items.zh: 刘京：别担心，你才学了半年。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Bié dānxīn, nǐ cái xué le bàn nián.
items.en: Liu Jing: Don't worry, you've only studied for half a year.

items.zh: 刘京：下次你一定能考好。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Xià cì nǐ yīdìng néng kǎo hǎo.
items.en: Liu Jing: You'll definitely do well next time.

data.topic: 会话2 · Dialogue 2 (能 vs 会)

items.py: Mǎlì: Hézǐ, nǐ huì kāi chē ma?

items.zh: 玛丽：我不会，我想学。在中国能学开车吗？
items.py: Mǎlì: Wǒ bú huì, wǒ xiǎng xué. Zài Zhōngguó néng xué kāi chē ma?
items.en: Mary: I can't, I want to learn. Can I learn to drive in China?

items.zh: 和子：能，但是考驾照很难。
items.py: Hézǐ: Néng, dànshì kǎo jiàzhào hěn nán.
items.en: Hezi: Yes, but the driving test is very hard.

items.py: Mǎlì: Nǐ néng jiāo wǒ ma?

items.zh: 和子：在中国我没有车，不能教你。你可以去驾校。
items.py: Hézǐ: Zài Zhōngguó wǒ méiyǒu chē, bù néng jiāo nǐ. Nǐ kěyǐ qù jiàxiào.
items.en: Hezi: I don't have a car in China, I can't teach you. You can go to a driving school.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (能 vs 会 vs 可以)

items.en: I can't come today. (能 = circumstance allows)
You can park here. (可以 = allowed)
He can run very fast. (能 = physical ability)

items.zh: 你考得怎么样？——考得很好。
items.py: Nǐ kǎo de zěnmeyàng? —— Kǎo de hěn hǎo.
items.en: How did you do? — Very well.

items.zh: 你考得怎么样？——考得不太好。
items.py: Nǐ kǎo de zěnmeyàng? —— Kǎo de bú tài hǎo.
items.en: How did you do? — Not too well.

items.py: Nǐ huì yóu yǒng ma? —— Huì.
Nǐ huì zuò Zhōngguó cài ma? —— Bú huì.
items.en: Can you cook Chinese food? — No.

items.py: Míngtiān nǐ néng lái ma? —— Néng lái.
